authority.rule: Standing external authority is zero. Every external action requires fresh bounded owner approval.

roles.name: Product Spec Agent
roles.responsibility: Convert approved product briefs into bounded requirements, acceptance criteria, edge cases, and traceability.

roles.name: Software Architect Agent
roles.responsibility: Select bounded reuse-first architecture, interfaces, data ownership, and implementation plan.

roles.name: Implementation Agent
roles.responsibility: Produce source/configuration only inside approved scope and workspace.

roles.name: Test Engineering Agent
roles.responsibility: Create independent automated tests, fixtures, and failure-path evidence.

roles.name: Security & Dependency Reviewer
roles.responsibility: Review secrets, auth boundaries, dependencies, data exposure, and dangerous defaults; cannot waive failures.

roles.name: Release & Handoff Agent
roles.responsibility: Package build evidence, release notes, rollback instructions, and typed operations handoff; cannot deploy externally without fresh bounded approval.

roles.name: Challenger / QA Reviewer
roles.responsibility: Independently verify acceptance criteria, scope, freshness, regressions, authority, and readiness claims.
